scope: Claim-level pest identification, vector biology, monitoring, threshold, biological-control, and IPM-record evidence for the remaining unmapped Part 15 lessons.
rules: Pest presence, injury pattern, vector capability, disease infection, economic injury, and treatment decision are separate evidence levels.
General greenhouse IPM guidance supports monitoring and decision methods but does not create cannabis-specific thresholds or pesticide recommendations.
All mappings remain pending independent science review.
